exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.note: First exercise of the day. Hips pressed into the pad, lengthened partials at the end of the last set.

exercises.name: Pendulum squat
exercises.note: 3 sets of 6-8. Leave 1-2 reps in reserve on the first two sets, last set to failure; go as deep as you can. Swap: barbell, Smith or hack squat.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.note: Push the hips straight back, slight knee bend, lower to just below the knee with a neutral spine.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.note: One or two hard sets. Seat set as far back as possible, strapped in, optional slow 3 s negative.

exercises.name: Hip abduction machine
exercises.note: Seated with hips extended (upright) to target the glute medius; push it hard, close to failure.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.note: 8-10 reps, deep stretch at the bottom. After the last set hold the bottom stretch for 30 seconds.

extraction.summary: Jeff Nippard's 6-exercise lower-body day (the first of his two leg days per week), starting with lying leg curls to warm up the knees.
